paragraphs.text:
What did you write? 
If you looked out the window, you saw the fire escape and fled 
down it. Very sensible! You’re now safe in another hotel. In the 
morning: if in Athens, go to the Athens Location Table; if in 
Cairo, go to the Egypt Location Table.  
If you locked the door, it unlocks and two men enter; if you 
hid in the bathroom, closet, or under the bed, you’re trapped and 
the men find you; if you readied a weapon, it’s ready; if you order 
them out of your room, they laugh. Go to 185.
